"""Retire closed raw logs and redundant successful trace receipts after compact evidence is committed."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import traceback
B=Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W=Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/diag-prefill-leaf-service-events-20261012')
F=W/'bench/results/2026-10-12-prefill-production-leaf-events'
L=Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.lint')
O=B/'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('leaf_retention_owner',O);m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
def pin(p):return dict(path=str(p),sha256=m.sha(p),bytes=p.stat().st_size)
with (B/'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
 fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
 out=B/'main-prefill-leaf-service-retention-root-v1';assert not out.exists();out.mkdir()
 setup=json.loads((B/'latest-update-main-finalization-host-root-v8/record.json').read_text())
 env=dict(PATH=str(L/'venv/bin')+':'+str(L/'bin')+':/usr/bin:/bin',HOME='/home/yayoi',LANG='C.UTF-8',LC_ALL='C.UTF-8',PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1',RUBYLIB=setup['environment']['RUBYLIB'],GEM_PATH=setup['environment']['GEM_PATH'])
 r=dict(active=True,passed=False,complete=False,commands=[],gpu_executed=False,source=pin(Path(__file__)),environment=env)
 def save():(out/'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
 owner=m.Owner(out/'commands',save);r['commands']=owner.commands
 def run(label,args,wall=180):
  c,so,se=owner.run(label,args,env,W,wall=wall,cpu=wall*2,rss_cap=4<<30,text_cap=16<<20,total_cap=64<<20,file_cap=16<<20)
  r.setdefault('evidence',{})[label]=dict(stdout=so.read_text(),stderr=se.read_text());save()
  assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code']==0,label
  return so.read_text()
 try:
  final=B/'main-prefill-leaf-service-model-finalization-root-v1/record.json';proof=json.loads(final.read_text());assert proof['passed'] and not proof['active']
  assert run('evidence-head',['/usr/bin/git','rev-parse','HEAD']).strip()==proof['commit']
  candidates=[];kept=[];retired_records=[]
  for p in sorted(B.glob('main-prefill-leaf-service-*-root-v*/record.json')):
   if p.parent==out:continue
   v=json.loads(p.read_text());assert not v['active']
   commands=v.get('commands',[])+v.get('guard_commands',[]);assert all(m.closed(c) and not c.get('cleanup') for c in commands)
   for c in commands:
    for row in c.get('owners',[]):
     live=m.identity(row['pid']);assert not live or live['start_ticks']!=row['start_ticks']
   for raw in p.parent.glob('commands/*'):
    if raw.is_file() and raw.suffix in ('.stdout','.stderr'):candidates.append((raw,'Closed raw command output; exact measurements/diagnostics/commands/closure retained in committed receipt.'))
   if 'main-prefill-leaf-service-fixture-' in p.parent.name:
    index=json.loads((F/'receipts/index.json').read_text());entry=index[str(p.parent)];archive=W/entry['archived'];a=json.loads(archive.read_text());assert a['passed']==v['passed'] and a['cell']==v['cell'] and a['service_summaries']==v['service_summaries'] and a['service_categories']==v['service_categories'] and a['commands']==v['commands']
    candidates.append((p,'Successful receipt contains redundant full API text; committed derivative keeps exact cell/categories/outcomes and all warning/error lines. Historical original hash retained.'))
    retired_records.append(str(p))
   else:kept.append(dict(original=pin(p),reason='Immutable structured source/build/lint/publication identity, currently pinned by diagnostic admission or baseline linter; review at next source/recipe boundary.'))
  model_root=B/'main-prefill-leaf-service-model-root-v1'
  for phase in ['startup','debug-on']:
   p=model_root/('xe-'+phase)/'record.json';v=json.loads(p.read_text());assert v['passed'] and not v['active'] and v['model_normal_close']
   assert all(m.closed(c) and not c.get('cleanup') for c in v['commands']+v['guard_commands'])
   for c in v['commands']+v['guard_commands']:
    for row in c.get('owners',[]):
     live=m.identity(row['pid']);assert not live or live['start_ticks']!=row['start_ticks']
   for raw in p.parent.glob('commands/*'):
    if raw.is_file() and raw.suffix in ('.stdout','.stderr'):candidates.append((raw,'Closed model/health/source-guard output; compact validation/categories/provider/fault/normal-QUIT evidence committed.'))
   # Original structured measurements remain byte-identical; compact derivatives are the next comparator input.
   kept.append(dict(original=pin(p),reason='Original pinned structured measurement receipt remains immutable until comparator consumers are advanced to committed derivatives; no separate raw-log consumer. Review at next copy-cohort comparison boundary.'))
  assert len({str(p) for p,_ in candidates})==len(candidates)
  manifest=[]
  for p,reason in candidates:
   assert p.is_relative_to(B) and p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink()
   st=p.stat();entry=dict(**pin(p),allocated_bytes=st.st_blocks*512,reason=reason,retained_evidence=str(F),consumer='Committed receipts and MODEL_RESULTS.json',status='planned')
   manifest.append(entry)
  result=dict(evidence_commit=proof['commit'],deleted_files=manifest,retired_original_receipts=retired_records,kept_structured_receipts=kept,
              raw_tensor_or_session_deleted=False,source_model_binary_service_or_gpu_state_changed=False,
              removed_logical_bytes=sum(v['bytes'] for v in manifest),removed_allocated_bytes=sum(v['allocated_bytes'] for v in manifest),scope='Retired closed raw logs and unnecessary successful API-bearing receipt duplicates only. Original structured build/lint/model receipts remain byte-identical where pinned. Actual free space may differ due to snapshots.')
  (F/'retention.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
  for entry in manifest:
   p=Path(entry['path']);assert m.sha(p)==entry['sha256'] and p.stat().st_size==entry['bytes'];p.unlink();entry['status']='deleted'
  (F/'retention.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
  # Current indexes point to the final normalized archives; the previous stage hashes remain in normalization manifests.
  p=F/'model-receipt-derivations.json';rows=json.loads(p.read_text())
  for row in rows:row['archived']=pin(Path(row['archived']['path']))
  p.write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
  p=F/'RESULTS.json';value=json.loads(p.read_text());value.update(model_runtime_qualified=True,model_runtime_scope='One32K+GEN16 instrumented event diagnostic; exact reported tokens/LP5 only.',model_results='MODEL_RESULTS.json',source_boundary_model_runtime_qualified=False);p.write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+'\n')
  (F/'controllers'/ (Path(__file__).name+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(dict(original=pin(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),indent=2)+'\n')
  run('retention-lints',['/bin/bash','tools/lint/run.sh',str((F/'retention.json').relative_to(W)),str((F/'RESULTS.json').relative_to(W)),str((F/'model-receipt-derivations.json').relative_to(W)),str((F/'controllers'/ (Path(__file__).name+'.json')).relative_to(W))],300)
  run('whole-reuse',[str(L/'venv/bin/reuse'),'lint','--quiet'],180)
  run('stage',['/usr/bin/git','add',str(F.relative_to(W))]);run('commit',['/usr/bin/git','commit','-m','chore(bench): retire closed prefill diagnostic raw logs'])
  run('push',['/usr/bin/git','push'],300);r['commit']=run('head',['/usr/bin/git','rev-parse','HEAD']).strip();assert not run('clean',['/usr/bin/git','status','--porcelain']).strip();r['removed_logical_bytes']=result['removed_logical_bytes'];r['removed_allocated_bytes']=result['removed_allocated_bytes'];r['complete']=True
 except BaseException as error:r.update(error=repr(error),traceback=traceback.format_exc())
 finally:r.update(active=owner.active is not None,finished_utc=m.utc());r['passed']=bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error'));save()
 print(json.dumps({k:r.get(k) for k in ['passed','complete','error','commit','removed_logical_bytes','removed_allocated_bytes']}));raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
